title: ScanRequest
description: Request body for queueing a security scan of one commit. Identifiers, statuses and timestamps are server-generated and cannot be supplied. Unknown properties are rejected.

commitSha.description: Full commit SHA (40 or 64 hexadecimal characters, case-insensitive; normalized to lowercase). Abbreviated SHAs and ref names are rejected.

triggerType.description: Informational. Not yet verified against GitHub events or OIDC claims.
